The "'''Threat Dossier'''" was a newsletter published by ''[[The Republic Journal of Law-Enforcement and Low-Intensity Conflict]]'' that profiled noteworthy individuals within the realm of scholarly analysis of non-warfare conflict. The newsletter was freely distributed to interested parties and widely read by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].
